question: What is a family secret that changed how you see your whole childhood?
story: At my own wedding, my grandmother stood up during the toast and called me by a name I had never heard in my life. Everyone laughed, sure she was just confused. She was not confused. After the reception, my mom pulled me into a quiet hallway and finally told me the truth. When I was two years old, my parents changed my first name completely. There had been another baby, a cousin who passed before I was born, and the family always planned to carry his name forward. My parents used it for two whole years, then changed their minds and never told a soul. My grandmother never got that memo. For thirty years, she quietly thought of me as him. That night she hugged me and whispered that both boys had finally made it to the same wedding. I have gone by my name my entire life. Turns out I am technically my own sequel.
